text:
Type: tall narrow frameless wall mirror
Use: checking an outfit, reflecting light in a narrow space; hallway, bedroom, kids room, living room
Style: retro, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: mirror glass with a frosted sandblasted dot pattern, frameless edges
Colors: silver mirror, frosted white dots
Shape: long slim vertical strip, flat and frameless, large frosted half-circles alternating along both edges, light and slender
Feel: playful, light, bright, fresh
Goes with: white walls, light wood, pastel or bold accents; Scandinavian, retro or playful rooms

product.name: LUNDAMO
product.description: The mirror can be hung vertically or horizontally to suit your needs and your space.
